questions.text: Explain how photosynthesis converts light into chemical energy. (4 marks)

criteria.description: States that carbon dioxide and water are the inputs (reactants)
States that glucose and oxygen are produced
Explains that chlorophyll in the chloroplasts absorbs light energy
Gives a correct balanced equation: 6CO2 + 6H2O -> C6H12O6 + 6O2 (words or symbols)

questions.text: A car travels 150 km in 2.5 hours. Calculate its average speed. (3 marks)

criteria.description: Correct answer of 60 km/h with unit
